# Floating Callout on Hover

```{r eval=FALSE}
library(vistime)
library(highcharter)

# Define timeline events as a list of lists
timeline_data <- list(
  list(
    name = "Project Kickoff",
    date = "2026-01-15",
    description = "Initial alignment meeting and scoping."
  ),
  list(
    name = "Alpha Release",
    date = "2026-04-10",
    description = "Core features deployed for internal review."
  ),
  list(
    name = "Beta Testing",
    date = "2026-08-01",
    description = "User acceptance testing and bug fixes."
  ),
  list(
    name = "Official Launch",
    date = "2026-11-20",
    description = "Public rollout and deployment."
  )
)

# Build the timeline chart
highchart() %>% 
  hc_chart(type = "timeline") %>% 
  hc_title(text = "Project Timeline Example") %>% 
  hc_add_series(
    data = timeline_data,
    name = "Timeline Events"
  )



```

```{r eval=FALSE}
library(highcharter)

# Define timeline data including superposed start milestones and intervals
superposed_timeline_data <- list(
  # --- Phase 1 & its starting Milestone ---
  list(
    name = "Milestone: Kickoff",
    date = "2026-01-15",
    description = "Zero-duration start milestone.",
    x = datetime_to_timestamp(as.Date("2026-01-15")),
    marker = list(
      symbol = "circle",     # Zero-duration circle marker
      radius = 9,
      fillColor = "#f45b5b",
      lineWidth = 2,
      lineColor = "#FFFFFF"
    )
  ),
  list(
    name = "Phase 1: Architecture & Setup",
    date = "2026-01-15",
    description = "Duration interval block following kickoff.",
    x = datetime_to_timestamp(as.Date("2026-01-15")),
    marker = list(
      symbol = "square",     # Rectangular base timeline block
      radius = 7,
      fillColor = "#2b908f"
    )
  ),
  
  # --- Phase 2 & its starting Milestone ---
  list(
    name = "Milestone: Alpha Lock",
    date = "2026-04-10",
    description = "Zero-duration transition milestone.",
    x = datetime_to_timestamp(as.Date("2026-04-10")),
    marker = list(
      symbol = "circle",     # Zero-duration circle marker
      radius = 9,
      fillColor = "#f45b5b",
      lineWidth = 2,
      lineColor = "#FFFFFF"
    )
  ),
  list(
    name = "Phase 2: Core Development",
    date = "2026-04-10",
    description = "Duration interval block for implementation.",
    x = datetime_to_timestamp(as.Date("2026-04-10")),
    marker = list(
      symbol = "square",     # Rectangular base timeline block
      radius = 7,
      fillColor = "#2b908f"
    )
  )
)

# Build the chart with a datetime axis to properly align superposed points
highchart() %>% 
  hc_chart(type = "timeline") %>% 
  hc_title(text = "Timeline with Superposed Zero-Duration Milestones at Intervals") %>% 
  hc_xAxis(type = "datetime") %>% 
  hc_add_series(
    data = superposed_timeline_data,
    name = "Roadmap Schedule"
  )

```




```{r}
library(highcharter)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Prepare historical blocks/events data spanning -3000 to 2100
timeline_data <- data.frame(
  name = c(
    "Early Bronze Age", 
    "Classical Antiquity", 
    "Middle Ages", 
    "Modern Era", 
    "Contemporary Era"
  ),
  label = c(
    "-3000 BC: Civilization rises", 
    "500 BC: Rise of Empires", 
    "500 AD: Medieval Period", 
    "1500 AD: Age of Discovery", 
    "2000+ AD: Digital Age"
  ),
  description = c(
    "Emergence of writing systems, early bronze metallurgy, and first major city-states in Mesopotamia and Egypt.",
    "Dominated by Greco-Roman civilization, the Han Dynasty, and major philosophical shifts across Eurasia.",
    "Characterized by feudalism, major religious expansions, and significant architectural feats.",
    "Marked by the scientific revolution, industrialization, and global exploration.",
    "Defined by rapid technological advancement, information age, and space exploration."
  ),
  x = c(-3000, -500, 500, 1500, 2000) # Numeric year mapping (negative for BCE)
)

# 2. Build the Highcharter Timeline
highchart() %>%
  hc_chart(type = "timeline") %>%
  hc_title(text = "World History Timeline (-3000 to 2100)") %>%
  hc_subtitle(text = "Interactive chronological blocks across millennia") %>%
  hc_add_series(
    data = timeline_data,
    type = "timeline",
    hcaes(x = x, name = name, label = label, description = description),
    dataLabels = list(
      allowOverlap = TRUE,
      format = '<b>{point.name}</b><br>{point.label}'
    )
  ) %>%
  hc_tooltip(
    useHTML = TRUE,
    headerFormat = "",
    pointFormat = '<b>{point.name} ({point.x})</b><br>{point.description}'
  ) %>%
  hc_xAxis(
    type = "linear",
    title = list(text = "Year (Negative = BCE, Positive = CE)")
  )



```
